Armadillo.headline: My Tush Hurts, and Argrider has no one else to blame
paragraphs: queens22 beat Argrider 148.14 to 145.68, the closest game in either conference, and Argrider gets to spend the week staring at the bench. Jaxon Smith-Njigba dropped 35.36 and did everything short of driving the team bus. Then Argrider started Isaiah Likely at tight end for 3.3 while Harold Fannin sat on the pine putting up 24.1. That is a 20.8-point swing in a game lost by 2.46. queens22 is 3-0 and did not have to do anything special to get there.
My Tush Hurts. Yeah, no shit.

YukonMike moved to 3-0, beating lowkeyeastt 128.76 to 101.04 behind Kyren Williams and CeeDee Lamb. lowkeyeastt runs a team called Wide Receivers' Galore, then started Khalil Shakir for 1.6 while Terry McLaurin's 19.7 sat on the bench. Galore of them, sure. Just not in the lineup.
Wide Receivers' Galore: plenty in the stockroom, nothing on the shelf.

xovsa0989 put 170.68 on Thomasg2488 and won by 75.84, the biggest beating of the week. Bijan Robinson, Brock Purdy and Drake London combined for 94.98, which means three guys from Waddlin to london outscored the entire Thomasg2488 roster by themselves. Thomasg2488's best player was Patrick Mahomes at 16.94. Thomasg2488 is 0-3 and the waddling has become a full sprint in the wrong direction.
Thomasg2488 didn't lose a fantasy game, Thomasg2488 got waddled on.

Juravieal beat cartercole 138.30 to 121.14 on a 41.4 from Jahmyr Gibbs, and managed it while leaving Brock Bowers (27.6) and Michael Wilson (25.9) on the bench. That is 43.8 unused points, the most anyone in APFN wasted this week, and the Phyrexian Dreadnoughts won anyway, because sometimes the sheer size of the thing makes up for the technique. Tate Dogg and Warren T drop to 0-3. Ja'Marr Chase gave them 24.8 and nobody else showed up to the party.
Tate Dogg and Warren T: 0-3 and in desperate need of regulating.

kbartelt07 picked up a first win, 127.78 to 122.26 over Rowdy0991, behind 26.2 from George Kittle. Burrow my Cook in Nabors has been threatening to put it in all season and finally did. Rowdy0991, meanwhile, had Matthew Stafford and Darren Waller on the bench outscoring the quarterback and tight end in the starting lineup by 10.84 combined, in a game lost by 5.52.
Rowdy0991 lost by 5.52 with 10.84 on the bench. Do the math, then go sit in the corner and think about it.

Grizzly.headline: Certified Coke Head scores like it, loses anyway
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 moved to 3-0 and still sits first in the 20-team power rankings, but chookonthecoast made it ugly. Certified Coke Head came in absolutely wired: 152.76, the fourth-highest score across both conferences, with Bijan Robinson at 35.3. It still lost, 161.70 to 152.76, because Jaxon Smith-Njigba put up 35.36 on the other side. chookonthecoast is 1-2 with a top-five team by all-play record, which is the fantasy version of doing everything right and still waking up with a nosebleed.
Fourth-best score in APFN and an L to show for it. Certified bad beat.

Dfiasco0 dropped the high score in all of APFN, 174.68 against adamgum, with Jahmyr Gibbs at 41.4, Drake London at 28.4 and Derrick Henry at 21.9. There is nothing little about Little Giants. It could have been bigger, too: like Argrider over in the Armadillo, Dfiasco0 started Isaiah Likely and benched Harold Fannin. adamgum got 31.28 from Brock Purdy and lost by 51, which is the kind of week where you check your phone, see the score, and put the phone face down for a while.
Little Giants, big-dick energy.

thatguyPegleg is 3-0 after beating IronMike1987 132.04 to 118.28, and nobody in APFN has more wins above expectation. The power rankings put The Nabers Cook Dope 10th of 20 by all-play record, so this undefeated run is being held together with tape and good timing. IronMike1987 is the mirror image: 0-3 with a roster that would have about 1.2 wins against an average schedule. Joe Burrow led the way with 21.58 and it was not enough.
3-0 on one good leg and a horseshoe stuck where the sun doesn't shine.

vpettijohnjr beat seachicken22 132.80 to 94.72, and seachicken22's number was the lowest score in either conference this week. Medicaid's Most Wanted left Michael Wilson's 25.9 and Zay Flowers' 15.4 on the bench and still won by 38.08. Kenneth Walker's 21.3 led seachicken22, and that was about the only thing worth watching.
seachicken22 didn't get beat, seachicken22 got plucked, cleaned and served with a side of fries.

Ghaztyz got off the mark by 2.88 over kingruddofrock, 120.54 to 117.66, with Brock Bowers going for 27.6. kingruddofrock started Drake Maye, who scored 3.76, while Bryce Young sat on the bench with 14.64. That swap alone is 10.88 points in a game lost by 2.88. Jakobi Meyers' 19.4 was also on the bench, just to rub it in. kingruddofrock is 0-3.
Maye I See Dem TD's? No. No, you may not.

Robber.headline: The armed robber just got robbed
paragraphs: Ghaztyz beat ArmedRodgery21 169.16 to 130.86, and in this league that is not a win, it is a shopping trip. LaPorta potty now gets its pick from a roster holding Jahmyr Gibbs, Josh Allen, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jonathan Taylor. ArmedRodgery21 had stolen two players in the first two weeks without losing one. Gibbs put up 41.4 in the loss, which only makes him look better on the way out the door.
Armed robbery, meet the getaway driver.

kbartelt07 posted the high score, 171.34 against adamgum, with George Kittle, Michael Wilson and Christian McCaffrey all over 21. McCaffrey was last week's steal and scored 21.6 in his first game for Rashee's Lambo. Reaper25 got 15.2 from George Pickens as its best player and nothing else worth reaping.
Stolen goods, full retail value.

queens22 is the only 3-0 team in the Robber League after beating thatguyPegleg 150.40 to 135.40. The Sundays are great. The robberies are not. De'Von Achane and Puka Nacua have scored 14.0 combined for Team queens22 since being taken, while the two players dropped to make room have outscored them by 27.8.
Undefeated on Sundays, 0-for-2 at the pawn shop.

Dfiasco0 beat vpettijohnjr 150.98 to 103.94. Hide Your Players is good advice, and vpettijohnjr has not been taking it: 0-3, robbed after both earlier losses, and about to be robbed a third time. Pukkake is starting to look less like a team name and more like a description of what keeps happening to the roster.
Three losses, three robberies. Pukkake is getting passed around like a rental.

Juravieal got a first win, 139.84 to 102.52 over cartercole, after losing Bijan Robinson and D'Andre Swift in back-to-back weeks. Drake London led the Collectible Cardigans with 28.4, and for once the Cardigans get to do the stealing. Jeantyfied Naberhood is about to be a little less furnished.
Cardigans off, ski masks on.

Through two rounds of steals, the best robbery in the league is still thatguyPegleg taking Kenneth Walker in week 1: 45.1 points since, 38.9 better than the player released to make room. Everyone else is still shoplifting gum.
